thread:
ivy: I opened a docs PR to deprecate the legacy alias for nebula2b and add migration guidance. The card now documents the new variant names, a short deprecation notice, and small JS+Python migration snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1515
cristian: What alias are we deprecating?
ivy: `nebula2b-legacy` is being removed in favor of explicit variants like `nebula2b-fp16` and `nebula2b-int8`. Added a migration note: "Aliases will be removed next quarter; pin explicit variants to ensure stable latency."
margo: Runtime asked for a cold-start note for int8: "int8 variants may show ~1.3x cold-start latency vs fp16". Can you add that under compatibility?
ivy: Added it. Also included a tiny JS snippet showing how to pin a variant and include a fallback: ```js
// prefer fp16, fallback to int8
const res = await client.generate({
  model: "nebula2b",
  variant: "nebula2b-fp16",
  fallback_variants: ["nebula2b-int8"],
  input: "Summarize the migration steps",
  max_tokens: 200
});
console.log(res.output[0].content);
```
cristian: Nice. Could we also show a CLI example so platform teams can quickly run it?
ivy: Added CLI note: `rwctl invoke --model nebula2b-fp16` and a sentence: "Use the explicit variant id to avoid runtime fallback variance."
